retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome studio portrait featuring voluminous 80s hair and bold vertical typography with a single primary color accent.
triggerTerms: high contrast black and white portrait with red circle accent

recipe.visualDefinition: A stark, high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with voluminous, textured dark hair, posed dynamically against a pure white background. The composition is anchored by a heavy, vertical geometric sans-serif title on the left, terminating in a vibrant red circular graphic element.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the organic texture of the hair and the geometric rigidity of the type
Vertical alignment of text balancing the diagonal lean of the subject
Monochrome palette punctuated by a single saturated red focal point
Subject's direct gaze creating a strong connection with the viewer
coreInvariants: High-contrast lighting that eliminates mid-tones in the skin

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered-right, occupying approximately 60% of the frame in a crouched, dynamic pose.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bold vertical text block on the far left acts as a structural pillar.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, follow the diagonal line of the arms down to the boots, then move up the vertical text on the left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space surrounds the subject, emphasizing the silhouette.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black (Subject clothing, hair, and typography)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant Red (Circular graphic at the base of the text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Extreme value contrast with zero mid-tone gray; the red is fully saturated.

characterSpecificRedesigns: The final character is replaced or followed by a solid red circle of equal width to the letterforms.

typesetting.lineBreakPattern: One letter per line or rotated 90 degrees

composition.relationshipToImage: Parallel to the frame edge, balancing the subject

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface used for maximum impact.
graphicDevices: Solid red circle as a terminal punctuation mark

candidateDirections.reason: Classic geometric foundation with circular counters.
Modern alternative with similar weight and clarity.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white studio portrait of a woman with very large, voluminous frizzy 80s hair, wearing black punk-glam clothing with silver chains, crouched on a pure white background. Ensure the lighting is stark with deep blacks and bright whites.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a vertical column of text on the far left using an extra-bold geometric sans-serif font. Rotate the text 90 degrees counter-clockwise. At the bottom of the text string, place a solid, vibrant red circle.

verificationChecks: Is the text oriented vertically on the left?
Is there a single red circle accent?
Is the hair texture voluminous and frizzy?

adjustableVariables: Accent color (e.g., change red to yellow or cyan)
mustRedesign: Do not replicate the exact facial features of the original subject
Ensure the typography is a generic geometric font rather than a proprietary logo

mustAchieve: Pure white background with no shadows
Extreme contrast in the subject's silhouette

postGenerationChecks: Verify text is rotated 90 degrees and vertically aligned
Confirm the presence of the red circle at the base of the text
Ensure hair texture is highly detailed and frizzy
Check that no mid-tones are present in the skin
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + voluminous 80s texture + vertical geometric sans-serif + single primary color geometric accent.
